reason: A Cordis plugin for orchestrating agent-driven issue workflows with workspace-scoped boards, per-issue sessions, automatic scheduling, and human approval gates.

summaries.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先任务编排插件，提供按工作区隔离的看板、独立任务会话、自动调度和人工审批流程。
summaries.en: A local-first DeepSeek Harness plugin that orchestrates issue workflows with workspace-scoped boards, per-issue agent sessions, automatic scheduling, and human approval gates.

capabilities: Creates and updates issues and comments through tools and RPC
Starts fresh agent sessions for issues
Provides human approval and acceptance gates
Streams board changes through Server-Sent Events
